title: nomad visa app
tagline: digital nomad visa application income verification using zkemail
description: The goal of this project is to have a proof of concept for verifying income requirements typical of a digital nomad visa. There are 40+ digital nomad visas that have emerged in the last 4-5 years and a typical characteristic of them is that they have a minimum income requirement. Often people just share screenshots to confirm income. I'd like to try out zkemail to have a more robust solution for this requirement. Then, I'll be able to explore further.
how_its_made: It is a simple nextjs application + zkemail to handle verification of income + email. v0.dev to handle basic setup. I used cursor to fine tune. zkemail docs to navigate with the help of claude ai.  The goal of the project was to get a proof of concept for income verification so its intentionally quite simple.
